pitch.why_it_stitches: 1.18M in 3 days with 876 comments arguing about it — a rising, controversial claim squarely in her exfoliation/barrier lane.
pitch.your_fit: She teaches barrier repair and warns against aggressive exfoliation ('that dead top layer is protecting you'). Switch-don't-quit: dry-brush the body if you like, never the face.

pitch.why_it_stitches: 2.65M views, 943 comments — a surprising aging claim people want a dermatologist to confirm or debunk.
pitch.your_fit: Her anti-aging guide explains why skin stops bouncing back with age; sleep lines vs permanent wrinkles fits that story. Needs her precise take on whether side-sleeping causes lasting creases.
